title: Liberals and conservatives
goal: I can explain what liberals and conservatives disagreed about, starting with the Church.
grammar: Contrast and concession: two groups, two ideas

items: I can say what liberals and conservatives disagreed about, starting with the Church.
I can say what many liberals and conservatives thought about federal and central government.
I can say what the two groups had in common.
I can explain why the labels did not explain everything.
I can use sin embargo, no obstante and aunque to contrast two ideas.
